description: Walk the user through steps one at a time; you can use numbers, dots, or bars as indicators, lay the flow out horizontally or vertically, and swap each step's content with a smooth transition.
interactionNotes: Clicking any indicator takes you straight to that step; in linear mode only the steps you have already reached are open. The back/next buttons mirror themselves in RTL, and on the last step the button becomes "Finish". The panel height also eases open between steps.

props.children: The steps; each inside a `<Step>` with a `title`, a `description`, and an optional `icon`.
props.step: If you want to own the current step yourself, pass this together with `onStepChange`; without it, the component starts from `initialStep`.
props.onStepChange: Called every time the step changes.
props.onFinalStepCompleted: When the last step is passed.
props.indicator: The shape of the indicators in horizontal layout; vertical always uses numbers.
props.orientation: Indicators above the content or in a rail beside it; below 520 pixels the rail collapses on its own.
props.transition: How content moves between steps; the height eases in every mode too.
props.linear: Linear navigation: you can only go back to steps you have already reached.
props.disableStepIndicators: Turns off clicking on the indicators.
props.showFooter: Whether the back/next buttons are shown.
props.backButtonText: Text of the back button; the default is Persian.
props.completeButtonText: Text of the next button on the final step.
props.backButtonProps: Extra props for the back button, such as `disabled`.
props.nextButtonProps: Extra props for the next button.
props.completedContent: Content that takes the place of the steps; if omitted, the buttons collapse and only the checks remain.
props.theme: Palette for the frame and controls; you can also override the colors from outside with the `--stepper-*` variables.
props.accentColor: Color of completed steps, the progress bar, and the next button; the text color on top is derived automatically from the color's lightness.
props.frame: The glass frame around the stepper.
props.radius: Corner roundness of the frame, in pixels.

tips: If it is a real form, turn on `linear`; that way the user cannot jump from step 2 to 4, and only the steps they have reached are open.
On mobile the layout becomes vertical and compact on its own; you do not need to write a media query.
Provide `completedContent` so a finish screen takes the place of the steps; otherwise only the checks and indicators remain.
Got several steppers one after another? Just change each one's `initialStep`; to sync with outside state, pass `step` and `onStepChange` as well.
